divergences.name: HurtArmorPacket
divergences.reason: The canonical manifest writes Armor Slots as unsigned var_u64, while the pinned gophertunnel Marshal writes ArmourSlots with Varint64 (zigzag_i64). This is an oracle conflict, not a normalization equivalence: the independent protocol documentation and the existing gophertunnel drift adjudication both identify the unsigned shape, so the hand-written oracle is the likely defect.
divergences.what_would_settle_it: A protocol 2168 capture of HurtArmor bytes, or an upstream gophertunnel correction backed by an authoritative serializer, must establish whether the field is unsigned VarLong or zigzag VarLong; then update the oracle or canonical correction and remove this entry.

evidence.summary: Pinned HurtArmour.Marshal calls io.Varint64 for ArmourSlots.
